summary: Server global component kept by esv::patrol::SplinesSystem: lookup tables between spline names and spline entities of the loaded levels, used by the crowd systems (esv::crowds::DetourSystem, PatrolSystem, SpawnSystem, DetourBuilderSystem). Seen.py context: idle levels (4 instances: one per world/level set).

fields.name: SplinesByName
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xD98B50 esv::crowds::DetourSystem::GetSplineInfo(..., FixedString const& name, ...) finds the name in the component with FUN_18027F180 (FixedString hash % bucket count at +8) and reads the value at +0x30 (ls::IndexedStorage<ls::ID<EntityHandleTraits>>) as the spline entity whose ls::SplineComponent gives the node positions. EoCServer.dll+0xA4F430 SplinesSystem::Update ensures entries keyed by the spline's (merged UUID) FixedString. Live: buckets 0x11/0x185, keys cap 0x10/0x100, size 0xA/0xED.

fields.name: SplineNames
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xA4F430: map at +0x40 keyed by the spline entity (FUN_18021E210 insert, FUN_18021F230 find with handle % bucket count) and values at +0x70 with stride 4 holding ls::FixedString (GetMergedUUID result assigned, FixedString copy on reallocation); removed entities are erased from both maps. Live: buckets 7/0xC1, keys cap 8/0x80, size 5/0x74.

open_questions: Whether the FixedString is the spline's merged UUID or its name (GetMergedUUID is used on insert).
